tools.name: binder_append
tools.description: Append one settlement leaf (x402 | stripe_mpp | agentcore) under your task_id. Free.

tools.name: binder_seal
tools.description: Seal ≥2 distinct rails under task_id into a portable Ed25519 binder (~$0.05 USDC on Base when paid).

tools.name: binder_verify
tools.description: Verify binder integrity (sig + ordered leaf hashes). Does not prove underlying settlement.
